surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Very low; the dorsal surface exhibits a largely homogenous texture with negligible dark-pixel clustering.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial linear rake marks on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible and open at the anterior apex of the dorsal view.
